about: uMed photo head (v0.42). Per-condition logistic heads (ovr) and a softmax over the leading label, on MobileNetV2 (ONNX model zoo, Apache-2.0, 8-bit) pooled features, scaler folded in. Trained on SCIN (Google/Stanford, SCIN Data Use License) train split only; see docs/v042_photo_dx_signoff.md. It can add causes and set an escalate-only floor; it never lowers urgency.
